message: Vector Rebel 3.2.50 prevents Baldree's PPE filter from selecting Brandon Barth or multiple people.
releaseNotes: My Tour PPE now requires exactly one live Responsible Party chip matching the inspector's full name before Apply Filters. Searches full name first rather than ambiguous two-character Ba prefix. If Vector selects a wrong or extra person, clears that filter and stops without starting inspection. Existing exact asset ownership checks remain binding.
